name: LiquiLens: read one bank's asset-quality evidence

parameters.content:
## Read one bank's public evidence
Run manually. No schedule, model, account or API key is needed for the LiquiLens request.

The example is Cosmos Co-operative Bank (`cosmos-ucb`), verified in the coverage tool on 2026-09-05. Edit the MCP node's JSON input to choose another covered slug. `banking_specialisation_coverage` lists covered banks.

Guide: https://liquilens.in/developers/recipes/n8n-bank-review.md

nodes.name: Read the limits with the figures

parameters.content:
## Keep the evidence in context
The final node keeps the full record: reporting period, availability and retrieval dates, source documents, missing figures, interpretation limits and historical-evidence eligibility.

Observed is a source status. It does not establish deposit safety, predict failure, or authorize credit. Historical, stale and unavailable states remain explicit.

MCP Client 1.1 stops on tool errors. This workflow produces research output and sends no messages or orders.
